images.filename: Legion of Honor at night (cropped).jpg
images.caption: Legion of Honor, one of San Francisco’s fine arts museums, at night in January 2017. The building is a full-scale replica of the French Pavilion at the 1915 Panama-Pacific International Exposition, which in turn was a three-quarter-scale version of the Palais de la Légion d’Honneur in Paris, by Pierre Rousseau (1782).
images.alt: Legion of Honor, one of San Francisco’s fine arts museums, at night in January 2017. The building is a full-scale replica of the French Pavilion at the 1915 Panama-Pacific International Exposition, which in turn was a three-quarter-scale version of the Palais de la Légion d’Honneur in Paris, by Pierre Rousseau (1782).
